Algo list:    algorithms_smoke.txt
CSV files:    pass7_smoke.csv (per GPU x algorithm x workload), pass7_smoke_samples.csv (per iteration), pass7_smoke_wave_probe.csv (per wave configuration); columns: CSV_FORMAT.md
Iterations:   16 measured + 0 warmup per GPU x workload x algorithm, 20 sorts per iteration
Cache flush:  256 MB read+write compute pass before every timed sort, then a DRAIN (pass5): a
              one-group dispatch on a private 4 KB buffer + UAV barrier right before the start
              timestamp, so the tail of the flush (barrier wait / cache maintenance a driver defers
              to the next dispatch) is no longer inside the timed window.
              NOTE: results before pass5 were measured WITHOUT the drain and are not directly
              comparable (flush mode full_legacy reproduces the old 'full'; on the RX 7900 XTX it
              added ~13 us to most iterations, on the RTX 5080 ~0.25 us).
Flush mode:   'full' for algorithms without their own. full = code + data cold (flush, drain);
              full_legacy = pre-pass5 full (no drain); full_ro = read-only flush, no drain
              (diagnostic); code = only code cold (flush before the upload, drain); data = only
              data cold (untimed warm-up run of the same dispatches, drain); none = no flush (drain)
              Drain suffixes (pass6 diagnostics): <mode>_d<N> = SPIN drain of about N us instead
              (an ALU-only dispatch, 4 groups x 64 threads, one 16-byte store per thread to the
              private 4 KB buffer, loop count from the per-GPU calibration below, + UAV barrier);
              _d0 = no drain (full_d0 = full_legacy); _dg = the pass5 one-group drain
